note: Set A is more accurate overall, with correct bindings for most equipment and finishes, whereas Set B contains several clear factual errors such as reading 'FRANKE' as 'RANKE', 'BED' as 'FA', and misattributing paint properties to the Wall Base (WB). Set A's errors are primarily minor truncations (e.g., 'TIERRA S' instead of 'TIERRA SOL'), which are less severe than Set B's misreadings and entity misbindings. Although Set B captures title block revision data missing in A, the higher number of incorrect claims makes it less reliable.
